components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--bs-primary, #0d6efd); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--bs-primary, #0d6efd); padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius, 0.375rem); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(var(--bs-primary-rgb, 13, 110, 253), 0.5); }

components.name: Toolbar Button
components.description: The working default: outline-secondary, small, for toolbars, filters and pagers.
components.css: .ds-btn-toolbar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; background: transparent; color: var(--bs-secondary, #6c757d); border: 1px solid var(--bs-secondary, #6c757d); padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius-sm, 0.25rem); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-toolbar:hover { background: var(--bs-secondary, #6c757d); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-toolbar:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.25rem rgba(var(--bs-secondary-rgb, 108, 117, 125), 0.5); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: var(--bs-primary, #0d6efd); } .ds-nav-brand { color: #fff; font-size: 1.25rem; margin-right: auto; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.5rem; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); outline: none; } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #fff; } .ds-nav-count { position: absolute; top: 0; right: -0.4rem; background: var(--bs-danger, #dc3545); color: #fff; font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0.15em 0.45em; border-radius: 50rem; }

components.name: Cover Card
components.description: Signature 2:3 cover frame with issue sticker, missing-tag sticker, hover-revealed favourite action and the lift.
components.html:
#12XML

components.css: .ds-cover { width: 160px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-cover:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); } .ds-cover-frame { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 2/3; border-radius: 8px; overflow: clip; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); background: linear-gradient(160deg, #2d4a7a, #b8432f); } .ds-sticker { position: absolute; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; color: #fff; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-sticker-issue { top: 8px; right: 8px; background: rgb(253 200 63 / 85%); color: #212529; border: thin solid #000; } .ds-sticker-alert { bottom: 8px; left: 8px; background: rgba(220,53,69,0.85); } .ds-cover-action { position: absolute; top: 10px; left: 10px; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: none; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-cover-frame:hover .ds-cover-action, .ds-cover-action:focus-visible { opacity: 1; } .ds-cover-action:hover { background: rgba(255,193,7,0.9); color: #212529; } .ds-cover-title { margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; color: var(--bs-body-color, #212529); } .ds-cover-meta { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #6c757d); }

narrative.overview:
CLU is the comic shop's back room, not its shop floor. Long boxes, a sorting table, everything labelled and filed. The colour in the room comes from the covers. Everything around them (navigation, toolbars, tables, forms) is plain, orderly and predictable, because the person in this room is working through a library of thousands of issues, not browsing a storefront. The feel is orderly: everything has a place, a label and a consistent position from page to page.

The system is built on Bootstrap 5.3 and has no palette of its own. Each user picks one of 26 Bootswatch themes or a local theme (Gruvbox Dark; Catppuccin Latte, Frappé, Macchiato, Mocha), and every colour on the page resolves through Bootstrap's --bs-* variables. CLU's own identity sits in the parts a theme does not reach: the 2:3 cover grid, the stickers on the covers, the hover lift, and the full-black reader. Those parts are the same on every theme.

Two looks are rejected outright. CLU is not a generic SaaS dashboard (gradient hero cards, KPI tiles, glassy panels), and it is not a streaming app (cinematic dark carousels and autoplay drama spread across the whole UI). The reader may go dark and immersive; the rest of the app does not.
keyCharacteristics: Theme-agnostic chrome: every page colour comes from the active theme's Bootstrap variables.
Covers are the only saturated content; the 2:3 cover frame is the system's signature shape.
Small fixed-colour stickers on covers, legible over any artwork.
Flat at rest; cards lift on hover; only overlays cast real shadows.
Bootstrap components used as shipped, with outline buttons as the working default.

rules.name: The Borrowed Palette Rule
rules.body: Page chrome never names a colour. It reads var(--bs-*) (or rgba(var(--bs-*-rgb), α)) so all 32 themes (stock Bootstrap, 26 Bootswatch, 5 local), light and dark, stay correct. A hex value in page CSS is a bug.

rules.name: The Sticker Exception
rules.body: Fixed colours are allowed only where the background is cover art or the reader's black, never the themed page. If it can sit on --bs-body-bg, it uses a theme variable.

rules.name: The Fill-and-Text Rule
rules.body: Themes drive .bg-x and .text-x from one variable, and templates put white text on fills and coloured text on the page. Never key a rule on a bare [data-bs-theme=dark]: the navbar carries that attribute on every theme, Latte included. A page rule that truly must differ on dark themes uses :root[data-bs-theme="dark"]; local theme files never branch on it at all.

rules.name: The Selection Rule
rules.body: Selected and drop-target covers use --clu-select (the theme primary pushed 30% toward --bs-emphasis-color, defined in collection.css), so a muted primary still marks a selection clearly and carries a white check.

rules.name: The No-Face Rule
rules.body: Don't load a web font or set a literal font-family. Read --bs-body-font-family or --bs-font-monospace, as the charts on Insights already do. Nothing in the app CSS sets a literal family today; keep it that way.

rules.name: The Filename Rule
rules.body: Anything the user might copy or compare (a path, a filename, a pattern) is set in mono.

rules.name: The Lift Rule
rules.body: Cover cards rise 5px (transform: translateY(-5px), 0.2s) on hover and come forward (z-index: 10). Lift means "this opens". Don't lift anything that doesn't.

rules.name: The 2:3 Rule
rules.body: A cover frame is always 2:3. Never let source pixels set the card size.

dos: Do read every page colour from var(--bs-*), and check a new screen on a light theme, a dark Bootswatch theme and Catppuccin Latte before calling it done.
Do keep cover frames at 2:3 with 8px corners, and put cover status in stickers 8px from the corners.
Do use btn-outline-secondary btn-sm for toolbar actions and save btn-primary for the one action the view exists for.
Do use Bootstrap Icons, Bootstrap components and the shared CLU toast and modal helpers before writing a new component.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for any animation beyond a hover transition, as the floating pager already does.
Do load static assets through url_for, never a hardcoded /static/.
donts: Don't write hex or rgb colours in page CSS; the only exceptions are stickers on covers and the reader.
Don't key styles on a bare [data-bs-theme=dark]; use :root[data-bs-theme="dark"] when a page rule must differ.
Don't build generic SaaS dashboard pieces: gradient hero cards, KPI tiles, glassy panels.
Don't spread streaming-app styling (cinematic dark carousels, autoplay previews) beyond the reader.
Don't load web fonts or set a literal font-family.
Don't lift or shadow things that don't open; flat is the resting state.
Don't use native alert(), confirm() or prompt().
